title: Dimensionless Strain (Fork eta): shear-Courant + Weissenberg non-dimensionalisation
hypothesis: Non-dimensionalising the EXP-512 strain promotes eps_ref from a per-world calibration (Ghost #46) to a universal engine constant STRAIN_STAR_REF. Two modes: (courant) strain*=strain*dt is a dimensionless shear-Courant/CFL number (per-step); (weissenberg) strain*=strain/|vorticity| is a dimensionless AND framerate-INDEPENDENT shear/spin ratio, consolidating EXP-510 vorticity. strain*=0 recovers EXP-509; dimensional path (no dt/vort) is byte-unchanged from EXP-512.

equations.courant: strain* = strain * dt   (CFL: shear accumulated per step relative to the cell)
equations.drain: E*_eff = beta_Z*(1-(strain*/eps_ref)^2),  eps_ref = STRAIN_STAR_REF (universal) for both modes

eps_ref_governance: STRAIN_STAR_REF is a PROTECTED constitutional constant (not a free L1 tunable): exposing it per-call would let a caller disable the mechanical firewall and would fragment H_verified content-addressing. Per-material variation must instead enter as a BOUNDED stiffness modulus chi in (0,1] DERIVED from the stalk material sector (declared state), eps_ref_eff = STRAIN_STAR_REF * chi -- declared-state response, never a verdict-bypassing knob (future fork).
backreaction_firewall: strain* feeds the VERDICT only; never mutates geometry, eigenvector, or forward E*. Dimensional path unchanged -> EXP-512 + all prior forks green.
engine_scope: engine/validity.py: bethe_citadel_strain_512 extended ADDITIVELY (dt, vorticity params; STRAIN_STAR_REF_512 + _VORT_EPS_513 constants). state/operators/confluence FROZEN.
assertions_fork_A: [2] backward compat: no dt/vort -> dimensional, byte-identical to EXP-512 (eps_ref=0.5)
[3] courant: strain*=strain*dt exactly; finer dt -> smaller strain* -> more permissive (monotone)
[4] courant universal: same STRAIN_STAR_REF rejects a per-step-unstable seam (strain*>eps_ref)
[5] weissenberg: strain*=strain/(|vort|+eps); rotation-dominated admits, shear-dominated rejects
[6] weissenberg FRAMERATE-INDEPENDENT: common rate-scaling of strain & vort -> identical Wi & verdict
[7] ghost #47 regularised: vorticity=0 finite (no div-by-zero), large strain* -> reject
[8] strain*=0 recovers EXP-509 dS_cit in every mode
[9] end-to-end: courant + weissenberg verdicts via citadel_strain_coupling on a shear scene
assertions_fork_B: [2] P_yz: weissenberg dS_cit invariant (strain & vorticity are Frobenius scalars)
